comments: Gate 3 approved. Authorises implementation and execution of all eight scenarios against approved plan TP-EC-11358-001 v1. Open questions Q-EC-11358-001 (concrete documents and organization accounts reproducing each precondition) and Q-EC-11358-002 (the live request shape and Control-History marker for each report API) are deferred to PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION, where they are captured from the running application as OBSERVED evidence and judged against the HUMAN_APPROVED method/path/status contract. Every Control History locator stays MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED until PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION resolves it, and the two report-API request/response shapes stay API_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED until captured live; no scenario asserts against an unverified field before then.

itemDecisions.comment: A transferred financial asset shows a consolidated Control History table (AC-EC-11358-001, UI). Precondition seeded per AMB-EC-11358-001; concrete document confirmed at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
Each Control History row shows the transfer date and both organizations (AC-EC-11358-002, UI). Structural presence of the three columns only, per AMB-EC-11358-003; no label or date-format assertion.
A document with no confirmed transfer shows no Control History table (AC-EC-11358-003, UI). Absence assertion.
Multiple transfers are ordered newest to oldest (AC-EC-11358-004, UI). Requires a document with at least two confirmed transfers.
The Control History table appears in the on-screen report view (AC-EC-11358-005, UI). Authoritative coverage of AC-EC-11358-005.

The Control History table appears when the report is exported via eoRequestExport (AC-EC-11358-005, API). Method/path/200 HUMAN_APPROVED at Gate 2; request params and response marker API_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED until PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
The Control History table appears when the report is requested via eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport (AC-EC-11358-005, API). Same authoritative-vs-unverified split as TS-EC-11358-006.
Document type determines whether the Control History table is produced (AC-EC-11358-006, UI). Financial Asset and Financial Asset Addendum show it; Supplemental Doc does not.
